observation: Fresh main preserved provider-authored browser_checks through federation, but selection still treated malformed or over-budget browser plans as executable even though the existing acceptance/browser-observation path would deterministically reject them later. changes: Normalize browser_checks at the federation boundary using the already-enforced browser URL, selector/text, scalar, boolean and settle-time semantics.
Propagate the existing eight-check browser acceptance budget upstream and mark malformed/over-budget browser plans non-executable for federated selection.
Keep the existing downstream browser observer and acceptance layer authoritative; no new browser product semantics were introduced.
